svg.title: Candidate Ranking — architecture
svg.desc: Candidate Ranking: Semantic matching + cross-encoder reranking · FastAPI · Next.js. No one can read 100,000 profiles for one job. This system scores every candidate against a job description, sends only a shortlist through a slower, more precise model, and returns a top 100 with the reasons behind each score.

svg.text: At query time a cheap combined score ranks everyone, and the

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: expensive cross-encoder reads only a shortlist of at most 300

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: job-candidate pairs, never the full pool.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A wider shortlist improves recall but slows the cross-encoder.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Scores also weigh location and education tier, and the code

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: has no bias audit, so the ranking supports a recruiter's review
